notes.title: Beta has Started!
notes.content:
It’s time!

The Horus: Desert Survivor Beta has officially begun, and the desert calls for champions. Join us right now and be among the first to wield magical weapons, build powerful decks, and face the corrupted gods.

What’s Playable in the Beta?


Explore the first floor of the campaign map
Choose your path and build your deck
9 magical weapons with unique effects
Face 2 mini bosses and 6 distinct enemy types
Collect and play with 30+ cards


Your journey begins here – and your feedback will shape what comes next.

🗓️ When?
April 18–21
This is a limited-time beta — don’t miss your chance to be part of it!

🔑 How to Join?

Head to our Steam page and click Request Access on the Playtest

Make sure to wishlist and follow the game!

Join our Newsletter or Discord  to chat with the devs and boost your chances of future tests

We’re listening.
Every bit of feedback helps us sharpen the gameplay and balance the challenge. Share your thoughts on Steam  or Discord — and thank you for helping bring Horus: Desert Survivor to life.

notes.title: Beta Is Coming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to announce that Horus: Desert Survivor is entering Beta – and we want YOU to join us in the sands!

What’s in the Beta?
- First floor of the campaign map, when travelling it you will pick your path and build your deck.
- 9 unique magical weapons to use
- 2 mini bosses
- 6 unique enemies
- Over 30 cards to find and use

Help shape the game with your feedback!

When?
🗓️ April 18-20
🕒 The gates will be open for a limited time – don’t miss out!

🔑 How to Join?
Make sure you’re following the game and have wishlisted it!
We’ll be sending out beta keys via:

Steam Playtest 
Our Newsletter  – join to increase your chances and talk directly with the devs!

We Need Your Feedback!
This beta is all about refining the gameplay and balancing the challenge. Your voice matters – share your experience, bugs, and suggestions on our Discord  or Steam forums.
